The '''Gauntlet of Crassus''' was a left-[[Limb/Legends|handed]] [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] created and owned by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[Crassus]]. When worn, the [[Glove/Legends|gauntlet]] not only bolstered the strength of the wearer's physical grip, but also provided a tenfold increase in the potency of their [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]]. The gauntlet was buried within the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] of its creator, located in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="FaD" />
